reason: It doesn't say who the payment partner is, what they take per transaction or when the money lands in my account, and on my margins that matters more than the 59 lari. I know my regulars by name already, so a loyalty reward and guest tracking don't do much for me. That's chain stuff.
objection: A hidden per-transaction fee on top of my card terminal fees, and maybe waiting days for my money when I need it to pay suppliers this week. Free for 3 months means nothing if every bill paid through the QR code costs me more.
would_change_my_mind: A named Georgian bank as the partner, a per-transaction fee in writing that's at or below what my terminal charges, and next-day payout.
